summary: DNS of the cubic cavity at Re = 1900 from rest to t = 100. It gives the start field of the Newton stage at Re = 1920.
description: DNS of the cubic cavity at Re = 1900 from rest to t = 100. The flow is close to the steady state but still oscillates (README). The stage writes the start field of 210_baseflow_newton/fp; its reference checks that the run reached its end time with the flow in the expected state: the norms of the last snapshot and the last probe value. The values are those of the run named under produced.

probe_vy_final.note: Last value of vy at the probe (0.25, 0.25, 0), column 3 of cav.his.
